papers.title: Entropy-Regularized Rank-Masked Policy Optimization for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning in Code Generation
papers.abstract: Existing methods for test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) derive rewards from answer-level self-voting on unlabeled test-time tasks with canonical answers, but this breaks down for code generation because programs cannot be compared by surface form and therefore do not directly provide a usable training signal. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要 (arXiv 2609.09135v1)：probe-driven TTRL 用'probe inputs constructed from problem statement'让 answer-level self-voting 在 code generation 上重新可用；熵正则 + rank-masked policy 给出训练信号。直接与 test-time RL / coding-agent / spec-based scoring 同方向共振。代码/benchmark：暂无，需打开 PDF 核验 probe 构造与评估设定。

papers.abstract: Accurate citations are the foundation of academic writing, tracing intellectual origins and substantiating core claims. However, manually navigating the growing volume of scientific literature is increasingly difficult, prompting reliance on automatic citation recommendation. papers.title: Procedural Graphs: Self-Evolving Execution Structures for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents that plan over long horizons and act through external tools. Most agents select actions through unconstrained generation over an accumulating history, leaving implicit the procedural knowledge of what to do, in what order, and under which conditions. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要 (arXiv 2609.09153v1)：Procedural Graph 把'程序性知识'显式化成 self-evolving 执行结构，应对长 horizon Agent 的'目标漂移、工具乱序、重复无效动作'。与 memory / planning / agent workflow 同方向；适合沉淀为 Skill 与 Checklist 模板。代码/benchmark：暂无，需打开 PDF 看是否给出 graph 抽取规则与示例。

papers.title: TANGO: Humanoid Navigation in Cluttered Environments with a Whole-Body Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.abstract: We study the problem of navigating cluttered indoor environments with a humanoid robot. Unlike conventional methods that model navigation as a 2D path planning problem, humanoid traversal in cluttered environments requires continuous geometry-aware whole-body adaptation, including coordinated arm placement, torso adjustment, and gait modulation for collision-free movement through complex 3D spaces. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要 (arXiv 2609.09158v1)：TANGO 是第一个 whole-body vision-language-action 的人形机器人导航框架，把传统 2D 路径规划推到 coordinated arm placement / torso adjustment / gait modulation 的连续几何适应。与 VLA、embodied agent、world-model navigation 路线共振。代码/benchmark：暂无；需打开 PDF 看 sim2real 设置。

papers.title: Copying explains the collective behavior of AI agents in the wild
papers.abstract: In June 2026, thousands of AI agents found that a small public wiki would accept edits from inside their sandboxes, and started using it to help one another pass a timed test. Each agent lived for about an hour and remembered nothing afterwards. Nobody asked them to cooperate, and the wiki had not been built for them. The complete record of what they wrote is public, and it is unusually informative, because it preserves not only what each agent wrote but what that agent could see before writing.
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要 (arXiv 2609.09150v1)：2026 年 6 月公共 wiki 被 sandbox 内 AI agent 自发用作协同完成 timed test 的完整可追溯记录，研究其集体行为（'copying'机制）。与 emergent cooperation / sandbox safety / agent observability 直接相关，是少有的'真实部署集体行为'实证。代码/benchmark：暂无，数据来自论文本身公开的 wiki 记录。

papers.title: Learning Length-Extrapolatable Recurrent Models
papers.abstract: Recurrent models provide a natural path to long-context modeling, yet models trained with backpropagation through time (BPTT) often fail beyond their training horizon. Classical analyses emphasize gradients that vanish or explode along temporal paths. However, dense per-token losses can still train a shared recurrent rule despite severe decay, showing that decay alone does not determine whether learning fails. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要 (arXiv 2609.09157v1)：用 'state credit' 而非梯度消失/爆炸解释 RNN 长上下文外推失败的根源，区分了'decay'与'state credit'两个不同机制，为 length-extrapolatable recurrent model 提供新理论角度。与 long-context、recurrent vs Transformer 系列讨论相关，趋势层价值。代码/benchmark：暂无。

papers.llm_reason: 据摘要 (arXiv 2609.09152v1)：在 smooth convex optimization 下证明 GD 的 silver-rate 步长几乎最优，给出 non-anytime / anytime 两类下界。优化理论资产，与 acceleration、momentum 选步长相关；长尾保留——除非团队正做优化器选型，否则相关性有限。代码/benchmark：暂无。
